newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med suspended near bourse session end.
newsitem.headline: Club Med suspended near bourse session end.

text.p: Shares in French vacations company Club Mediterranee were suspended limit up for the third time at 1532 GMT and will requote at 431 francs at the open on Tuesday, the SBF stock markets association said on Monday.
The stock will have a new upper limit of 474.10 francs and a lower limit of 387.90 francs when it requotes.
Club Med shares ended the day 21.24 percent higher than their opening price as investors welcomed the appointment of the head of Euro Disney to lead the group.

Club Med announced last Friday it was replacing its chairman Serge Trigano with Philippe Bourguignon, head of the Disneyland Paris theme park, and surprised the market with a net loss for the 1995-96 year of 743 million francs ($131.3 million).
